title: Structured error envelope
description: The one error shape every assistant endpoint returns. It exists so a client can act on a failure — retry, reauthenticate, reconcile — instead of parsing a message string. It must never contain prompts, reasoning, file contents, tool payloads, secrets, or realtime tokens.

code.description: Bounded machine code, e.g. STATE_REVISION_MISMATCH, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, RESOURCE_BUSY, RUN_TERMINAL.

snapshot.description: The authoritative state, returned with a conflict so the client reconciles without a side channel.
